options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: credential_cache
options.description: This option can be set or modified when using REST. If not specified in POST, ONTAP uses default values for the TTLs. It requires ONTAP 9.11.0 or later.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: force_ontap_version
options.description: Override the cluster ONTAP version when using REST. The behavior is undefined if the version does not match the target cluster. This is provided as a work-around when the cluster version cannot be read because of permission issues. See https://github.com/ansible-collections/netapp.ontap/wiki/Known-issues. This should be in the form 9.10 or 9.10.1 with each element being an integer number. When C(use_rest) is set to auto, this may force a switch to ZAPI based on the version and platform capabilit

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: lambda_config
options.description: Configuration parameters for AWS Lambda proxy functionality. These option and suboptions are only supported with REST.

options.name: nfsv3
options.description: status of NFSv3.

options.name: nfsv3_64bit_identifiers_enabled
options.description: Specifies whether 64-bit support for NFSv3 FSIDs and file IDs is enabled. Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv3_connection_drop
options.description: Specifies whether the dropping of a connection when an NFSv3 request is dropped is enabled. Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv3_ejukebox_enabled
options.description: Specifies whether NFSv3 EJUKEBOX error is enabled. Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv3_fsid_change
options.description: status of if NFSv3 clients see change in FSID as they traverse filesystems. REST support added in collection version 23.2.0 and requires ONTAP 9.11.0 or later.

options.name: nfsv3_hide_snapdir
options.description: Specifies whether hiding a snapshot directory under a NFSv3 mount point is enabled (support from ONTAP 9.13 onward). Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv3_mount_root_only
options.description: Specifies whether the SVM allows MOUNT protocol calls only from privileged ports (port numbers less than 1024). Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv4
options.description: status of NFSv4.

options.name: nfsv40_acl
options.description: status of NFS v4.0 ACL feature

options.name: nfsv40_acl_preserve
options.description: Specifies if the NFSv4 ACL is preserved or dropped when chmod is performed. In unified security style, this parameter also specifies if NTFS file permissions are preserved or dropped when chmod, chgrp, or chown are performed. Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv40_read_delegation
options.description: status for NFS v4.0 read delegation feature.

options.name: nfsv40_referrals
options.description: status for NFS v4.0 referrals. REST support added in collection version 23.2.0 and requires ONTAP 9.13.1 or later.

options.name: nfsv40_write_delegation
options.description: status for NFS v4.0 write delegation feature.

options.name: nfsv41
options.description: status of NFSv41. usage of C(nfsv4.1) is deprecated as it does not match Ansible naming convention.  The alias will be removed. please use C(nfsv41) exclusively for this option.

options.name: nfsv41_acl
options.description: status of NFS v4.1 ACL feature

options.name: nfsv41_pnfs
options.description: status of NFSv41 pNFS.

options.name: nfsv41_read_delegation
options.description: status for NFS v4.1 read delegation feature.

options.name: nfsv41_referrals
options.description: status for NFS v4.1 referrals. REST support added in collection version 23.2.0 and requires ONTAP 9.13.1 or later.

options.name: nfsv41_write_delegation
options.description: status for NFS v4.1 write delegation feature.

options.name: nfsv42_seclabel_enabled
options.description: Specifies whether NFSv4.2 or later security label is enabled. Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv42_xattrs_enabled
options.description: Specifies whether NFSv4.2 or later extended attributes is enabled. Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv4_64bit_identifiers_enabled
options.description: Specifies whether 64-bit support for NFSv4.x FSIDs and file IDs is enabled. Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv4_fsid_change
options.description: status of if NFSv4 clients see change in FSID as they traverse filesystems. REST support added in collection version 23.2.0 and requires ONTAP 9.13.1 or later.

options.name: nfsv4_grace_seconds
options.description: Specifies the grace period for clients to reclaim file locks after a server failure. Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv4_id_domain
options.description: Name of the nfsv4_id_domain to use.

options.name: nfsv4_lease_seconds
options.description: Specifies the lease seconds of the NFSv4 clients. If it is inactive for more than the time displayed, all of the file lock states on a node might be lost Supported only with REST.

options.name: nfsv4_numeric_ids
options.description: status of NFSv4 numeric ID's.

options.name: ontapi
options.description: The ontap api version to use

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: root
options.description: This option can be set or modified when using REST. It requires ONTAP 9.11.0 or later.

options.name: security
options.description: This option can be set or modified when using REST. It requires ONTAP 9.11.0 or later.

options.name: service_state
options.description: Whether the specified NFS should be enabled or disabled. Creates NFS service if doesnt exist.

options.name: showmount
options.description: Whether SVM allows showmount. With REST, supported from ONTAP 9.8 version.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether NFS should exist or not.

options.name: tcp
options.description: Enable TCP (support from ONTAP 9.3 onward).

options.name: tcp_max_xfer_size
options.description: TCP Maximum Transfer Size (bytes). The default value is 65536. This option requires ONTAP 9.11.0 or later in REST.

options.name: udp
options.description: Enable UDP (support from ONTAP 9.3 onward).

options.name: use_lambda
options.description: Specifies if AWS Lambda proxy functionality should be used to connect to the ONTAP system. Supported only with REST.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: Whether to use REST or ZAPI. always -- will always use the REST API if the module supports REST. A warning is issued if the module does not support REST. An error is issued if a module option is not supported in REST. never -- will always use ZAPI if the module supports ZAPI.  An error may be issued if a REST option is not supported in ZAPI. auto -- will try to use the REST API if the module supports REST and modules options are supported.  Reverts to ZAPI otherwise.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vserver
options.description: Name of the vserver to use.

options.name: vstorage_state
options.description: status of vstorage_state.

options.name: windows
options.description: This option can be set or modified when using REST. It requires ONTAP 9.11.0 or later.
